Backstage Log In Create Account × DS-1X Distortion Where to Buy --> Home Effects Pedals Distortion/Overdrive/Fuzz DS-1X Home DS-1X Features Specs Guide/Articles --> Guide/Articles Accessories --> Accessories Downloads --> Downloads Support Plug Into the Future of Distortion The DS-1X launches the famous BOSS distortion into a new era of expression, delivering unmatched performance for guitarists seeking the ultimate tone. This advanced stomp combines decades of pedal expertise with the latest technologies, bringing you a breakthrough sound experience that’s only possible with BOSS innovation. Prepare to be amazed—the inspiring and ultra-responsive DS-1X will change your thinking about distortion pedals forever. View the Gallery Introduction Movie Features Advanced distortion pedal with next-level sound, feel, and tonal response BOSS’s innovative MDP technology and high-speed DSP deliver a superior playing experience that’s unattainable with analog distortion circuits Powerful real-time processing adapts to your playing to provide ideal distortion tones in every register Enjoy perfect sounds over the entire fretboard, from tight, crisp tones on the low strings to fat, singing tones on the highest notes High-clarity distortion sound that’s never muddy or boomy, even when playing two or more notes at once Ultra-responsive to volume changes and picking dynamics Very low noise, even with high-gain settings Drive, High, and Low knobs control multiple internal parameters at once, providing sophisticated sound shaping not available in typical pedals Striking appearance with exclusive chrome knobs and control plate, plus vintage silver knob for battery compartment access BOSS five-year warranty High-Def Distortion for Modern Players The DS-1X completely redefines the distortion stomp with trailblazing BOSS MDP technology. Its distortion tones are perfectly balanced no matter where you play on the neck, even with maximum gain. You get tight response on the low strings and fat, singing tones on the highest notes, plus supreme definition when playing arpeggios and complex chords.
